description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the activated parameters ratio (expressed as a percentage on the x-axis, ranging from 100% to 25% with a logarithmic-like spacing) and the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL, on the y-axis, ranging from approximately 11.5 to 14.0) for four different model configurations: “Transformer” (red dashed line), “Only MoHD FFN” (gray square markers with solid line), “Only MoHD ATTN” (dark blue circle markers with solid line), and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” (light blue cross markers with solid line). The “Transformer” baseline remains nearly flat across all parameter ratios, hovering around 11.5 Eval PPL. “Only MoHD FFN” starts near 11.5 at 100% and slightly decreases to about 11.4 at 75%, then rises to approximately 11.8 at 25%. “Only MoHD ATTN” begins at 11.5, increases to 12.1 at 75%, and sharply rises to 14.0 at 25%. “MoHD ATTN + MLP” starts at 11.5, rises to 12.0 at 75%, and reaches 13.1 at 25%. All lines show increasing perplexity as the activated parameter ratio decreases, with “Only MoHD ATTN” exhibiting the steepest degradation at low parameter ratios.
